_comment: Where the kit's releases live; the update check reads this. Releases are git tags named <tagPrefix><semver> (v1.0.0) in gitUrl, and path is the kit folder inside that repo ('' = the repo root). If the kit moves, change this file, plus the URLs in README.md, INSTALL.md and .claude-plugin/ (the plugin test lists every file that names the home).
